arm_definitions.nutpie: PyMC models: nutpie.compile_pymc_model(model) (numba backend), as WP47. Stan models: nutpie.from_pyfunc around the bridgestan callable (counted). nutpie.sample(draws=1000, tune=1000, chains=4, cores=1, seed, store_mass_matrix=True); nutpie defaults otherwise (target_accept 0.8, gradient-based diagonal mass matrix)
arm_definitions.nutpie-counted: PyMC models only: nutpie.from_pyfunc around the same from_pymc callable the py-* arms use, wrapped in a call counter; uniform(-2,2) starts. Verifies nutpie's n_steps against counted callbacks
arm_definitions.nutpie-drawmetric: as nutpie with use_grad_based_mass_matrix=False (nutpie's draw-variance mass matrix, closer to Stan/oWALNUTS)
arm_definitions.py-default: owalnuts.sample(counted callable, threads=1) at the package defaults (f097391c); init=None (numpy uniform(-2,2) starts, no target evaluations). Callable: owalnuts.from_pymc(model) (PyMC) or a bridgestan StanModel.log_density_gradient callable, propto=False, jacobian=True, Stan exception -> zero density (Stan models)
arm_definitions.py-levels1: py-default with Tuning(max_refinement_levels=1): only the coarsest level; a leaf whose local energy error exceeds delta stops the orbit (retained exhaustion rule 'stop')
arm_definitions.py-nutpiemetric: py-default with mass = 1 / (chain-mean final nutpie mass_matrix_inv of the same model and seed) and Adaptation(adapt_mass=False): step adaptation only
arm_definitions.rs-default: Rust gap-harness, sampler::Sampler defaults at f097391c (Tuning::default, Adaptation::default, Metric::diagonal), starts from Init::default() = best_of(16) via candidate_starts, threads=4
arm_definitions.rs-meanaccept: rs-default with Adaptation::Custom(WarmupConfig::new(0.8).with_dual_averaging_acceptance(MeanTrajectoryAcceptance) + DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION + DEFAULT_METRIC_REGULARIZATION): only the dual-averaging statistic changes, from the per-leaf coarse endpoint exp(-|dH_local|) to Stan's accept_stat__
arm_definitions.rs-nutslike: rs-meanaccept with max_refinement_levels(1) and the retained exhaustion rule AcceptUnlessDivergent (a leaf is kept unless H rises > 1000 above H_0): the closest the facade gets to Stan/nutpie NUTS
arm_definitions.rs-nutpiemetric: rs-default with Metric::fixed_diagonal(1 / chain-mean final nutpie mass_matrix_inv), step adaptation only

order: seeds outer; models in 'models' order; arms in the order python_nutpie_arms (minus nutpie-counted on Stan models), python_owalnuts_arms, rust_arms. Strictly sequential, one cell at a time. nutpie runs first because the *-nutpiemetric arms transplant its metric.
per_cell_record: gradients total / warmup / sampling / start selection / initial evaluation, counted callbacks and the reported count, min bulk and tail ESS and max rank R-hat over the functionals, divergences, mean tree depth, mean gradients per retained transition, mean leaves built (oWALNUTS), fraction of selected leaves refined, retained reverse-check calls, final step size per chain, acceptance statistic (nutpie mean_tree_accept over draws; Rust harness: the arm's own dual-averaging statistic over the last 100 warmup transitions; the Python package exposes none), ESS per gradient (total and sampling-only)
functionals: every unconstrained coordinate, plus theta_1..theta_8 for both Eight Schools parametrisations; ESS, R-hat by owalnuts.summary (matches ArviZ to 1e-6)
statistic: per (model, arm): geometric mean over the three seeds of min bulk ESS / total gradients (warmup + sampling + start selection + initial evaluations; nutpie: n_steps warmup + sampling). gap(model) = ln(ESS/grad nutpie) - ln(ESS/grad default) on the same path (py-default for the Python path, rs-default for the Rust path; nutpie is the same arm for both). Fraction of the gap closed by arm X: f_X = [ln(X) - ln(default)] / gap, pooled over a model set as the sum of numerators over the sum of gaps.

decomposition.accounting: A = |ln(reported nutpie/default ratio) - ln(callback-verified ratio)| / reported gap, pooled over the PyMC models on the Python path; the verified ratio uses counted callbacks for py-default and the nutpie-counted arm's counted/n_steps factor applied to nutpie. Start selection (0 calls in Python, best-of-16 in Rust) is reported as the difference between the Python and Rust default gaps that it explains.
decomposition.model_class: descriptive: the default gap on the PyMC models vs on gp_pois_regr / lotka_volterra, with the eight / eight_nc bridge (same model, PyMC callable vs Stan) on both paths
decomposition.kernel: f for py-levels1, py-delta2, rs-levels1, rs-delta2
decomposition.adaptation: f for rs-meanaccept (step statistic), py-/rs-nutpiemetric (mass matrix), and the nutpie-side counterpart ln(nutpie) - ln(nutpie-drawmetric) as a fraction of the gap; rs-nutslike reports what remains when the kernel and statistic are both NUTS-like

predictions.P1: accounting explains < 15 % of the PyMC-model gap (A < 0.15)
predictions.P2: py-levels1 recovers at least half of the gap on the PyMC models (pooled f >= 0.5)
predictions.P3: py-delta2 recovers less than py-levels1 on the PyMC models (pooled f_delta2 < f_levels1)
predictions.P4: on gp_pois_regr and lotka_volterra, owalnuts-default stays >= 0.9x nutpie per gradient (each model, both paths)
predictions.P5: (own) the step-size statistic is the largest single adaptation factor: rs-meanaccept pooled f on the PyMC models >= 0.5 and larger than rs-nutpiemetric's
predictions.P6: (own) the mass matrix explains little on gauss100 (|f_nutpiemetric| < 0.25 there, the identity is already optimal) and less than the step statistic on hier
predictions.P7: (own) the gap on the bridge model eight_nc (Rust path) is within a factor 1.25 of the PyMC eight gap (Python path): the path is not the cause
predictions.P8: (own) the Rust and Python default ESS per gradient agree within 0.8-1.25x on every PyMC model (start selection costs 64 calls, < 1 % of a run)

decision_rule: FROZEN. If py-levels1 or py-delta2 closes >= 50 % of the pooled gap on the three PyMC models (Python path) AND the same arm on the Rust path passes at least as many gate cells as rs-default on gp_pois_regr + lotka_volterra (6 cells) with no fewer than 5/6, recommend a preregistered default-candidate study for that arm. Otherwise report the decomposition and recommend documentation only. The diagnostic arms (meanaccept, nutslike, nutpiemetric, nutpie-drawmetric) do not trigger the rule; any follow-up they suggest is reported as a separate, non-rule recommendation. No default is changed by this study.
